mt.text: Il-Kelma. Tkellem. Isma'. Ikteb.
Għajnuna b'xejn bil-vuċi għal min għandu d-dislessija.
Magħmula f'Malta, l-ewwel bil-Malti, u miftuħa għal kull lingwa.
Inti titkellem, hi tikteb. Inti tipponta, hi taqra. U l-ittri ċ, ġ, ħ, ż u għ dejjem f'posthom.
Għaliex Il-Kelma?
Il-lingwa Maltija jistħoqqilha postha fid-dinja diġitali.
Għal snin twal qalulna li l-Malti huwa lingwa żgħira wisq għat-teknoloġija.
Il-kitba bil-vuċi, il-qari b'leħen għoli u l-għajnuna fl-ortografija waslu għal-lingwi l-kbar tad-dinja. Il-Malti ħafna drabi baqa' lura.
L-intelliġenza artifiċjali qed tbiddel dan.
Il-Kelma turi li l-kompjuter jista' jisma' l-Malti, jiktbu sew u jaqrahulek lura.
Taħdem fil-kaxxi taċ-chat li n-nies jużaw kuljum, fuq pjattaformi differenti.

Il-fundatur, Clifford Debattista, jgħid: "Bdejt Il-Kelma biex nagħmel il-kitba bil-Malti ta' kuljum aktar faċli. Issa rrid li tgħin lil oħrajn ukoll, biex ħadd ma jibqa' lura minħabba l-qari jew il-kitba."
Mhux biss il-Malti.
Il-Kelma tifhem u titkellem bl-Ingliż u bit-Taljan ukoll, u kull kumment jinqara bil-lingwa tiegħu.
Kull lingwa hija pakkett sempliċi, għalhekk jistgħu jingħaqdu lingwi oħra.
It-tama tagħna hija li kull komunità li l-lingwa tagħha tħalliet lura tkun tista' ġġib il-lingwa tagħha wkoll.
X'tagħmel Il-Kelma?
F9, Ikteb: titkellem bil-Malti, bl-Ingliż jew bit-Taljan, u Il-Kelma tikteb fil-kaxxa taċ-chat. Qatt ma tibgħat il-messaġġ waħedha. Inti tiċċekkjah u tibagħtu.
F11, Aqra: agħżel kwalunkwe test u isimgħu b'leħen naturali.
F7, Ipponta u aqra: ipponta fuq test li ma tistax tagħżel, bħal kummenti f'live chat, u isimgħu.
F6, Aqra l-kummenti l-ġodda: agħmel kaxxa madwar live chat darba, u kull kumment ġdid jinqara b'leħen għoli.
F8, Għinni ngħidha: għid x'trid tfisser, u tagħtik sentenza ċara bil-Malti.
F4, Il-Karta: pad tal-kitba kalm għal min għandu d-dislessija, b'ittri kbar, kuluri, riga tal-qari, u buttuna biex tirranġa l-ittri.
Titgħallem miegħek: titgħallem kliem Malti ta' kuljum minn dak li taqra, imma kelma waħda biss, qatt ismijiet jew messaġġi.
Il-ħabib Kelma joqgħod kwiet fil-kantuniera tal-iskrin. Juri x'qed jiġri bil-burdati tiegħu u jkellmek, minflok ma joħroġlok kaxxi.
Issa, il-buttuni. Dawn huma l-buttuni ta' fuq il-keyboard, biex taħdem malajr.
F9 biex tikteb bil-vuċi. F11 biex taqra t-test magħżul. F7 biex tipponta u tisma'. F6 biex tibda jew twaqqaf il-qari tal-kummenti. F8 għal Għinni ngħidha. U F4 biex tiftaħ il-Karta.
Biex tibdel il-lingwa: agħfas fuq il-ħabib Kelma, imbagħad agħfas il-bandiera. Kull darba tinbidel: Malti, English, Italiano. Il-ħabib jgħidlek il-lingwa l-ġdida b'leħen għoli.
Privatezza u rispett.
Il-vuċi tiegħek tinbidel f'kitba fuq il-kompjuter tiegħek stess.
Il-Kelma qatt ma tibgħat messaġġ minflokok, u qatt ma żżomm ismijiet jew messaġġi ta' nies oħra.
Xogħol li għadu għaddej.
Il-Kelma għadha żgħira u qed tikber. Kull test, idea u korrezzjoni jagħmluha aħjar.
Għat-teknoloġija assistiva: min jagħmel software jew tagħmir għal persuni b'diżabilità jista' jżid il-vuċi Maltija ta' Il-Kelma fil-prodotti tiegħu.
Appoġġ u msieħba.

Nilqgħu b'qalbna l-programmi tal-Unjoni Ewropea, gvernijiet u entitajiet pubbliċi, universitajiet, skejjel, organizzazzjonijiet, fondazzjonijiet, kumpaniji żgħar u kbar, u nies minn kull rokna tad-dinja.
Tistgħu tagħmlu fork tal-proġett, tissuġġerixxu ideat, tirranġaw affarijiet jew iżżidu lingwa ġdida. Kull għajnuna tintlaqa' bi gratitudni kbira.
Biex tinstallaha: niżżel il-proġett, agħfas darbtejn fuq "Install Il-Kelma", u wara agħfas darbtejn fuq l-ikona ta' Il-Kelma fuq id-desktop.
Jekk Il-Kelma tgħinek, tista' tappoġġjaha b'kafè. Agħfas il-buttuna l-oranġjo, Ixtrili kafè. Kull kafè jgħin lil Il-Kelma tikber. Grazzi mill-qalb.
Il-Kelma hija b'xejn u mhix għall-bejgħ. Grazzi lill-MLRS tal-Università ta' Malta u lil kull min għen.
Il-Kelma. Tkellem. Isma'. Ikteb.

en.text: Il-Kelma. Speak it. Hear it. Write it.
A free voice helper for people with dyslexia.
Made in Malta, Maltese first, and open to every language.
You speak, it writes. You point, it reads. And the letters ċ, ġ, ħ, ż and għ are always right.
Why Il-Kelma?
The Maltese language deserves its place in the digital world.
For many years, Maltese speakers were told that our language was too small for modern technology.
Voice typing, reading aloud and spelling help arrived for the world's big languages. Maltese was too often left behind.
Artificial intelligence is changing that.
Il-Kelma shows that a computer can listen to Maltese, write it correctly and read it back.
It works in the chat boxes people use every day, on different platforms.
The founder, Clifford Debattista, says: "I started Il-Kelma to make everyday writing in Maltese easier. Now I want it to help others too, so that nobody is left behind because of reading or writing."
Not only Maltese.
Il-Kelma already understands and speaks English and Italian too, and every comment or message is read in its own language.
Each language is a simple language pack, so more languages can join.
Our hope is that any community whose language was left behind can bring its own.
What does Il-Kelma do?
F9, Write: speak in Maltese, English or Italian, and Il-Kelma writes it into the chat box. It never presses send. You check it and send it yourself.
F11, Read: select any text and hear it in a natural voice.
F7, Point and read: point at text you cannot select, such as live chat comments, and hear it.
F6, Read new comments: draw a box around a live chat once, and every new comment is read aloud in its own language.
F8, Help me say it: say what you mean, and it suggests a clear sentence in Maltese.
F4, the Kelma Pad: a calm writing pad made for dyslexia, with big letters, easy fonts, colours, a reading ruler, and a button to fix the letters.
It learns with you: it learns everyday Maltese words from what it reads, but only single words, and never names or messages.
Kelma Buddy sits quietly in the corner of your screen. He shows you what is happening with his moods and talks to you, instead of popping up boxes.
Now, the shortcut keys. These are keys on your keyboard, so you can work quickly.
F9 to write with your voice. F11 to read the selected text. F7 to point and listen. F6 to start or stop reading comments. F8 for Help me say it. And F4 to open the Kelma Pad.
To change the language: click Kelma Buddy, then press the flag. Each press changes it: Maltese, English, Italian. Buddy tells you the new language out loud.
Privacy and respect.
Your voice is turned into text on your own computer.
Il-Kelma never sends a message for you, and it never keeps other people's names or messages.
Work in progress.
Il-Kelma is young and growing. Every test, idea and correction makes it better.
For assistive technology: makers of software or equipment for people with disabilities can add Il-Kelma's Maltese voice to their own products.
Support and partners.
We warmly welcome European Union programmes, governments and public entities, universities, schools, organisations, foundations, companies small and large, and people from every corner of the world.
You are welcome to fork the project, suggest ideas, fix things or add a new language. Every bit of help is received with real gratitude.
To install it: download the project, double-click "Install Il-Kelma", and then double-click the Il-Kelma icon on your desktop.
If Il-Kelma helps you, you can support it with a coffee. Press the orange button, Buy me a coffee. Every coffee helps Il-Kelma grow. Thank you from the heart.
Il-Kelma is free and not for sale. Thank you to MLRS at the University of Malta, and to everyone who helped.
Il-Kelma. Speak it. Hear it. Write it.
